name: Pleo
def: Animatronic toy dinosaur modelled on a baby Camarasaurus about a week old, designed by Caleb Chung, who helped create the Furby, and first sold by Ugobe.
facts: Designed by Caleb Chung, one of the Furby's creators
First sold by Ugobe and now made by Innvo Labs
Its large body and head leave room to hide sensors and motors
